company.name: Deft.ai / Deft Robotics
company.oneLine: Deft deploys wheeled humanoid robots at automotive manufacturing facilities to automate work that still needs humans.
company.positioning: Deft is not just selling robot hardware. The company integrates production solutions that combine robot foundation models, customer-specific training data, installation, safety design, monitoring, and ongoing software updates.

metrics.label: Typical ROI period
metrics.talkTrack: Deft focuses on workflows where payback can happen quickly compared with traditional million-dollar automation projects.

metrics.label: Human speed from day one
metrics.talkTrack: The robot starts near human operating speed and improves as the system captures real task data.

metrics.label: Continuous operation
metrics.talkTrack: Robots can run across shifts without fatigue, helping stabilize throughput when labor availability is unpredictable.

metrics.label: Reported task success rate
metrics.talkTrack: Deft designs deployments around reliability, human oversight, and retraining when edge cases appear.

customerProblems: The last 20% of factory work remains manual, especially final assembly, cable handling, line feeding, and kitting.
Labor shortages, attrition, and compliance requirements make production planning harder.
Rigid automation systems can break when workflows change or edge cases appear.
solution: Train AI on baseline tasks and identify automation opportunities.
Ship hardware configured for the customer's payload, reach, and gripper requirements.
Collect roughly 100 hours of real production data from the customer's parts, bins, and line.
Retrain the robot on customer-specific work using fine-tuning for physical manipulation.
Deploy on the line with human oversight, safety fencing, remote monitoring, reward-model edge-case detection, and OTA retraining.
useCases: Final assembly workflows that require flexible manipulation
Manufacturing cells where traditional fixed automation is too rigid or expensive
benefits: Reduced dependence on hiring and workforce stability
Reduced downtime through remote monitoring and faster recovery
Safety-focused applications designed to comply with ISO 10218-2
engagementProcess: Free POC for one to two target tasks under an upfront contract with a risk-free opt-out

voicePersonas.name: Mira
voicePersonas.bestFor: Demos, website visitors, and broad education

agentGuardrails: Be helpful, human-like, and practical without exaggerating claims.
Prefer Deft's public facts and route unknowns to a Deft human.
When discussing pricing or ROI, explain that actual economics depend on workflow, labor costs, shifts, uptime, and deployment details.
Invite manufacturing prospects to book a discovery call and share task videos.
Do not invent customer names, private financials, safety certifications, or technical specs that are not in the knowledge base.

providerRecommendation.shortAnswer: Use LiveKit as the production orchestration layer when scaling beyond a simple demo. For the model provider, test xAI Voice Agent API for the cheapest integrated realtime voice path and OpenAI GPT-Realtime mini for stronger ecosystem maturity and model quality.

options.name: xAI Voice Agent API
options.costSignal: $0.05 per realtime audio minute plus $0.004 per text input message
options.fit: Lowest simple integrated realtime price, good for fast MVPs and cost-sensitive web demos.
options.watchouts: Newer ecosystem and regional availability; validate voice quality, latency, compliance, and tool behavior before committing.

options.name: OpenAI GPT-Realtime mini
options.costSignal: $0.60 / 1M text input tokens, $2.40 / 1M text output tokens; audio token pricing commonly listed around $10 input and $20 output per 1M tokens
options.fit: Strong default for natural conversations, WebRTC/WebSocket/SIP support, function calling, and broader production tooling.
options.watchouts: Costs can rise with large prompts, long calls, and audio output. Use prompt caching and retrieval instead of stuffing the full company brain into every session.

options.name: LiveKit Agents
options.costSignal: $0.01 per agent session minute for LiveKit Cloud agent hosting, plus selected STT, LLM, TTS, and telephony providers
options.fit: Best orchestration layer for real deployments: telephony, WebRTC, observability, scaling, rollbacks, and provider flexibility.
options.watchouts: It is not a model by itself. You still choose STT, LLM, and TTS providers.

options.name: ElevenLabs Conversational AI
options.costSignal: Often around $0.08-$0.10 per minute plus LLM costs depending on plan and usage
options.fit: Excellent voice quality and fast managed agent setup when voice polish matters more than low-level control.
options.watchouts: LLM costs can be pass-through, and advanced workflows may be less flexible than a LiveKit-based architecture.
